author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새 10만 마리 이상 · 나그네새 수만 마리
habitat: 평지, 개활지, 농경지 부근 숲, 농촌 인가와 시가지의 나무

months.note: 봄과 가을에 지나가며, 번식지에서는 3월~5월 중순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 전국을 지나는 흔한 나그네새이며, 한반도 남단에서는 큰 무리가 여럿 겨울을 난다. 평지와 개활지, 농경지 근처 숲, 농촌 마을과 시가지의 나무에서 지내고, 큰키나무 위에 모여 집단으로 번식하기도 한다. 동물성과 식물성 먹이를 가리지 않고 먹는다. 시베리아 남부, 알타이, 몽골 북부, 아무르, 만주 등지에서 번식하고 한국 남부, 일본 서남부, 타이완 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: bare grey skin around the nostrils and bill base
black plumage with a strong purple gloss

art.subject: Rook (Corvus frugilegus), adult in winter (Korean flocks from October to March): entire plumage black with a strong purple and blue gloss; loose shaggy feathering on the thighs; a patch of bare greyish-white skin around the nostrils, the bill base and the chin, edged by a few sparse feathers and smaller than in European Rooks; slender, sharply pointed black bill; dark eye; black legs and feet.
art.pose: walking on the ground in farmland as part of a large flock
art.scene: Korean winter farmland in the far south with bare trees at the field edge; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking on bare farmland: purple-glossed black plumage, baggy thigh feathers, peaked crown, slender pointed black bill with bare greyish-white skin at its base
adult, head detail in side profile: bare greyish-white skin around the nostrils, bill base and chin, slender pointed bill with a gently curved culmen, peaked crown
art.build: Medium-large crow, a little smaller and slimmer than a Carrion Crow and much smaller than a Large-billed Crow. No crest; the crown feathers lie flat, but the forehead is steep and the crown peaked, highest above the eye. Bill about as long as the head, slender and sharply pointed, with a gently curved culmen and no heavy arch. Legs medium length, black; walks on fields with a rolling gait, the loose thigh feathers forming baggy trousers. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail medium length, rounded to slightly wedge-shaped in flight. Flies in large flocks on long, fingered wings.
avoid: Do not paint a massive arched bill and a domed forehead; that is Large-billed Crow.
Do not cover the adult's bill base with black bristles like a crow; adults show bare pale skin there.
Do not paint a grey nape or a white collar; that is Daurian Jackdaw, which often flocks with Rooks.
Do not paint the bare face pink or red.
